description: This file is an Angular service (DataService) responsible for fetching food-related data such as categories and items. It provides methods for retrieving categories, items (optionally filtered by category or search terms), and individual items by ID. It uses mock data as fallback if real API calls fail or are unavailable.

classes.name: DataService
classes.description: An Angular Injectable service that manages fetching and filtering food categories and items from an API, with fallback to mock data.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of food categories from the API, returning mock data on failure.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Fetches a list of food items, possibly filtered by category or search term, with fallback to mock data.

methods.name: getItemById
methods.description: Retrieves a single food item by its ID, with fallback to mock data.

methods.name: filterMock
methods.description: Filters the mock food items array based on category ID and search terms.
